intent: Fix RFC8414 issuer-path discovery plus bounded complete loopback callback framing/concurrency; preserve original exact issuer binding and domain-only callback acceptance. Public complete_callback signature/answers unchanged.

source_authorities.discovery: application/discovery.rs owns parsed issuer URL candidates; original identifier compared exactly into issuer_matches, consumed by unchanged domain DiscoveryAccepted
source_authorities.callback: domain/machine.rs Command::Callback owns current state/resource/phase/consumption; application/owner.rs private AuthCallbackOutcome maps that same locked Decision and closes candidate receiver before terminal/accepted effects
source_authorities.bounds: infrastructure/callback.rs owns four scoped connection futures including waiting candidate sends, one queued candidate, 4096-byte headers, two-second absolute connection budget and unchanged whole-attempt timeout
source_authorities.effects: private prepared exchange keeps captured attempt/resource/endpoints; shared effect completion preserves existing typed exchange/publication failures
